name: Suunto & Custom FIT Exporter
description: Uploads rides or custom rowing FIT files to Suunto (via Runalyze) with automatic Runalyze login & cookie refresh, and hijacks Biketerra's native Strava/Intervals upload with custom FIT data.

settings.label: Runalyze Username or Email
settings.description: Used to automatically log in and refresh PHPSESSID & REMEMBERME when expired.

settings.label: Runalyze Password
settings.description: Your Runalyze password for automatic session refresh.

settings.label: Runalyze Cookie Header (Optional / Fallback)
settings.description: Auto-filled on login, or paste manually (PHPSESSID=...; REMEMBERME=...).
